input: <NEWprefix>_input.json; all physical parameters, spatial packet, boson regulator, variational ranks, frequencies and propagation times explicit

pure_helpers.geometry(config): Actual 3^3 geometry and ordered-frame h components; recomputes 108-mode reference and occupied 54-mode sea. No inherited state.
pure_helpers.fields(config): Five-coordinate quantum DVR, canonical electric-volume inertias, same-law Peierls coefficient/current/contact arrays and scalar potential.
pure_helpers.configurations(geo,field,config,rank): Actual determinant lists in N=54,55,53, current-generated single/double pair directions and source-relevant charged extensions.
pure_helpers.sector(masks,geo,field,config): Same projected H with exact CAR Slater-Condon matrix elements, exact identity Gram/whitener, quantum boson kinetic and own ground state.
pure_helpers.source_operator(source,target,packet,cre: Actual rectangular 108-mode CAR source; combine with identity on the FULL common boson family. Raw projection losses must remain visible.
pure_helpers.leakage(sector,geo,field,state): Exact coherent omitted-determinant action of original one-body H at selected quantum nodes, with coefficient screening at 1e-11. Absolute residual has energy units, is not a gap/error bound.
pure_helpers.lanczos(h,vector,shift,steps): Reorthogonalized finite spectral quadrature with original unnormalized vector norm. Complete degenerate spectral weights are not single-eigenvector probabilities.

array_semantics.state_order: fermionic determinant outer, tensor boson node inner; fields order phi,xcos,xsin,ycos,ysin
array_semantics.orbitals: 108x108 unitary, real-space four-component rows and reference eigenmode columns. Keep cross-kx/ky coherences when forming local densities.
array_semantics.masks: Decimal-string 108-bit CAR occupation masks; N=54,55,53 are ACTUAL electron counts, not excitation labels.
array_semantics.charged_initial: Normalized retained projection of cdagger(f)|neutral_ground>. Source norm loss is recorded, not hidden.
array_semantics.charged_kicked: Exact exp(i kick_strength Q_xcos) charged_initial. No second projection or normalization, no body-conditioning operation.
array_semantics.baseline_states/kicked_states: Paired real-time states of exactly SAME projected H and baseline preparation, at specified times. Site receiver means are inclusive number-density observables, not squared overlaps with a source.
array_semantics.charge_excess: Actual local density minus the untouched neutral ground density. Sum is one in charged trajectories; local excess need not be positive.
array_semantics.field_purity: Tr rho_field^2 of full reduced five-coordinate density; finite-basis entanglement, not classical stochastic field purity.
array_semantics.current_retarded/field_retarded: All four common-q sin/cos polarization profiles; commutator spectra use BOTH signs. Contact expectations are separately supplied.
array_semantics.source_G: Raw-norm addition/removal Lanczos spectra of same neutral state and same H family, G_R addition denominator z-Delta+, removal z+Delta-. Finite Krylov quadrature, not complete full-CAR diagonalization.

review_boundary: NEW actual calculations and source/input-bound natural-exit capsules are scientist evidence. Independent future Wave15 should audit; these files are NOT silently added to Wave14 or older frozen reviews.
scientific_limits: Conditional ordered-frame 3D lepton-sector variational model with supplied scalar potential and no bare transverse magnetic restoring term. Omitted pairs, severe boson regulator, frozen matrix orientation, zero nonuniform longitudinal coupling, spin/bundle inputs and absent Lorentz/bulk/strong-sector closure stay explicit. Variational gaps are not rigorous bounds.
